label: champ_0128_rival_01
text: Ta-ta-tachán! Here’s our battle court for today![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0128_rival_02
text: OK, right... Mm-hmm! Always important to check\nwhat environment your Pokémon’ll be battling in![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0128_rival_03
text: The battlefield can have these teeny effects on\nyour Pokémon’s balance and stuff, y’know?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0128_rival_04
text: Anyway, sorry I sorta dragged you here. But a\nlittle pre-Gym warming up should do you good![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0128_rival_06a
text: That’s an L for me! Man, you’ve gotten so good![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0128_rival_06b
text: That’s a W for me! You battled real well, though![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0128_rival_07
text: I think that should be enough of a warm-up![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0128_rival_08
text: You and your Pokémon should be all set now.\nHere—take these as thanks for the battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0128_rival_09
text: There’s just two Gyms remaining. Then all that’ll\nbe left is to try out to be a Champion! Give it all\r\nyou got![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0128_rival_10
text: Now let’s get you back to the Gym lobby![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
